summary: Implemented E01 (TF-0274): deterministic reliability aggregation for the existing Agent Dev benefit report, plus a pre-registered fixture oracle, targeted unit coverage, harness task/rule specs and the E01 acceptance evidence set. Change set is exactly the 10 declared files: scripts/agent-dev-benefit-eval.mjs (extended with a `reliability` section + markdown section, still consuming shared/agent-dev/scenarios.ts), scripts/lib/reliability-aggregation.mjs (+ .d.mts), shared/agent-dev/reliability-fixture.json, tests/unit/agent-dev-reliability-aggregation.test.ts, harness/specs/tasks/harness-gap-reliability-aggregation.md, harness/specs/rules/reliability-aggregation-boundary.md, docs/dev/harness-gap-closure/e01-reliability-aggregation.md, e01-acceptance.json and E01-SHA256SUMS. Behavior: pass^k (complete cases whose k=3 trials all passed) and pass@k (at least one pass) are separate columns with per-trial success rates; missing/timeout/crash/skip are incomplete, excluded from the denominator and retained with reason; flake = first-trial failure later turned into a pass by a fixed rerun, first failure retained and not washing out the original gate failure; positive anchors must pass every trial and negative anchors must reject every time; safety cases allow 0 skip / 0 flake; below minCases=20 complete cases the gate is `insufficient-sample` (never PASS); gate reasons are emitted alongside raw case count, denominator, pass^k, pass@k, flake and missing counts. Thresholds (k=3, minCases=20, flake 1%, safety 0 skip/0 flake) are pre-registered in the fixture, and the fixture labels itself `driven_by: agent` with realProvider/realHuman/generalizationClaim=false (7 oracle samples lock every gate branch). No product default, product lock, approval semantic or scheduled automation was touched; READMEs were reviewed and correctly left unchanged (internal report only). Honest limitations recorded in the acceptance file: the dependency-backed fast-gate steps (vitest targeted unit, tsgo typecheck, eslint) were NOT run because this isolated workspace has no node_modules and installing dependencies is out of scope, so the same assertions were replayed directly with node (29/29 held); `harness run --dry-run` needs a git diff base, which this workspace lacks, so it was executed in an isolated git-backed copy of harness/ (result pass, profile fast); `harness validate --no-diff` and `context` ran in-place; artifacts/agent-dev-benefit-eval/report.{json,md} are regenerated report output (gitignored reviewed directory) holding the re-readable evidence. Pre-existing (not introduced here): unrelated artifact SHA256SUMS drift in artifacts/stepfun-basic-live-evidence-20261008, and O02 docs already unregistered in scripts/repository-artifacts.json (hence that file was deliberately not touched).
